47	       with their qualified name (never the default ``<function ... at 0x...>``

65	            # then sort by the serialized key to prevent hash inconsistencies when dict ordering varies.

74	            # so hash randomization on element types cannot shift cross-process iteration order.
75	            serialized_set = [serialize_object(e) for e in obj]
76	            return sorted(serialized_set, key=lambda x: (type(x).__name__, str(x)))

- **`task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/definitions/partition_mappers/wait_policy.py`** — lightweight `WaitForAll`/`MinimumCount` (construction, equality, hashing, repr; same `n=0` error).
